answer: Dispute bounty: anyone may stake 50 POA to accuse an account of being a fake duplicate. Each new account posts a 100 POA bond, held over a 14 day horizon. A proven fake loses the bond, and the accuser gets 60 percent. One fake costs 100 POA, 10 cost 1000, 100 cost 10000, and each extra fake adds hunters' payoff, while an honest user bonds once and is refunded. Evidence must be txids and timing logs on the jetty ledger, so a fable with no data is rejected. Five random jurors check each case. Limit: well hidden fakes can still wait out the horizon.
